payload.description: Give your Agent a small animated pixel face on a 64x64 screen, shown right inside Leaf. Pixoo turns your Agent's portrait into a tiny animated face on a 64x64 pixel display. In Leaf you see a faithful copy of a Pixoo screen, and each display belongs to exactly one Agent. It is a quiet face, not a dashboard: it never shows text, notifications or a clock. For now you set its mood by hand, and it does not yet follow your Agent's conversations by itself.
